div.div: مُجْذٍ [act. part. n. of 4]. مِثْلُ الأَرْزَةِ المُجْذِيَةِ عَلَى الأَرْضِ, (S,) or كَالأَرْزَةِ المجذية على وَجْهِ الارض, (TA,) occurring in a trad., (S, TA,) describing the unbeliever, (TA,) means [Like the pine-tree] that is firm (S, TA) and erect [upon the ground]. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
